evals.name: 14-Point Directory & Core Infrastructure Scaffolding
evals.prompt: Scaffold a new enterprise Angular 19+ application directory layout following the 14-point specification with core singletons, shared UI layouts, and domain features.
evals.expected_output: Generates the complete 14-point directory tree under src/app including core/ (guards, interceptors, services, strategies, handlers), shared/ (components, layouts, directives, pipes, validators), and features/.
assertions: Establishes clean core, shared, and features layer separation
Configures generic ApiService with typed HTTP verb methods
Implements AppTitleStrategy for route document title synchronization
Generates layout shells with MainLayoutComponent and Header/Sidebar

evals.name: Functional Guards, Interceptors & Routing
evals.prompt: Implement functional authentication guards, Bearer token HTTP interceptors, and modular lazy-loaded feature routes with component input binding.
evals.expected_output: Creates functional CanActivateFn guards using inject(), pure HttpInterceptorFn interceptors with request cloning, and modular route definitions using loadComponent and withComponentInputBinding().
assertions: Implements authGuard as functional CanActivateFn using inject()
Implements authInterceptor as pure HttpInterceptorFn with request cloning
Leverages withComponentInputBinding() for route parameter injection
Enforces 100% Standalone architecture with zero NgModule declarations

evals.name: Automated Scaffolding Compliance Audit
evals.prompt: Audit an Angular codebase using audit_enterprise_scaffolding.py to verify compliance with the 14-Point Enterprise Scaffolding Specification.
evals.expected_output: Executes scripts/audit_enterprise_scaffolding.py against the workspace, returning structured diagnostics or JSON compliance score verifying all 14 checkpoints.
assertions: Verifies presence of core services, guards, and app.config.ts
Verifies absence of legacy NgModule declarations across source files
Outputs structured compliance score and checkpoint results
